Name: Johanan, Son of Careah
Summary: Johanan, son of Careah, was one of the captains who came to Gedaliah at Mizpah and warned him against Ishmael's plot.
RelatedPeople: Gedaliah, Son of Ahikam; Careah, Father of Johanan; Ishmael, Son of Nethaniah
LifeLesson: A warning ignored is still a warning given: Johanan did his duty.
